text:
I rewrote the title and outcome of `mastermind-live` myself, because the task had already landed and nobody owned it any more.

- **Title:** it had the owner's name in it, which breaks the global rule. It is now "Figma live: review rules, Systems map, Live board".
- **Outcome:** it was one long run-on sentence with no checklist. It is now four ticked items with a Figma link beside each proof. I wrote the ticks from the original outcome text, not from the owner's actual asks. That session's brief isn't in the task folder, so I couldn't check them against what was asked.

I didn't take a screenshot, because the landing named no site pages and the layout check was skipped. The text check came back clean. The new outcome went in as one `assign` line in `session.jsonl`, and a `rewrote` line went into `flags.jsonl`. No code was touched.
That inbox line is my own finished report coming back to me, so there's nothing new to act on. The rewrite is already in `session.jsonl` and `flags.jsonl`, and I'm stopping here.
